verses.translation: For the end, a Psalm of David among the Hymns.

translations.ron: Dumnezeule, milostiveşte-Te spre noi şi ne binecuvintează, luminează fa?a Ta spre noi şi ne miluieşte!
translations.grk: Εἰς τὸ τέλος, ἐν ὕμνοις ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυίδ.

verses.translation: God be merciful to us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us. Pause.

translations.ron: Ca să cunoaştem pe pământ calea Ta, în toate neamurile mântuirea Ta.
translations.grk: Ὁ Θεὸς οἰκτειρήσαι ἡμᾶς, καὶ εὐλογήσαι ἡμᾶς, ἐπιφάναι τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἐφʼ ἡμᾶς· διάψαλμα.

verses.translation: That men may know thy way on the earth, thy salvation among all nations.

translations.ron: Lăuda-Te-vor pe Tine popoarele, Dumnezeule, lăuda-Te-vor pe Tine popoarele toate!
translations.grk: Τοῦ γνῶναι ἐν τῇ γῇ τὴν ὁδόν σου, ἐν πᾶσιν ἔθνεσι τὸ σωτήριόν σου.

verses.translation: Let the nations, O God, give thanks to thee; let all the nations give thanks to thee.

translations.ron: Veselească-se şi să se bucure neamurile, că vei judeca popoarele cu dreptate şi neamurile pe pământ le vei povătui.
translations.grk: Ἐξομολογησάσθωσάν σοι λαοὶ ὁ Θεὸς, ἐξομολογησάσθωσάν σοι λαοὶ πάντες.

verses.translation: Let the nations rejoice and exult, for thou shalt judge the peoples in equity, and shalt guide the nations on the earth. Pause.

translations.ron: Lăuda-Te-vor pe Tine popoarele Dumnezeule, lăuda-Te-vor pe Tine popoarele toate. Pământul şi-a dat rodul său.
translations.grk: Εὐφρανθήτωσαν καὶ ἀγαλλιάσθωσαν ἔθνη, ὅτι κρινεῖς λαοὺς ἐν εὐθύτητι, καὶ ἔθνη ἐν τῇ γῇ ὁδηγήσεις· διάψαλμα.

verses.translation: Let the peoples, O God, give thanks to thee; let all the peoples give thanks to thee.

translations.ron: Binecuvintează-ne pe noi, Dumnezeule, Dumnezeul nostru. Binecuvintează-ne pe noi, Dumnezeule, şi să se teamă de Tine toate marginile pământului.
translations.grk: Ἐξομολογησάσθωσάν σοι λαοὶ, ὁ Θεὸς, ἐξομολογησάσθωσάν σοι λαοὶ πάντες.

verses.translation: The earth has yielded her fruit; let God, our God, bless us.

translations.grk: Γῆ ἔδωκε τὸν καρπὸν αὐτῆς· εὐλογήσαι ἡμᾶς ὁ Θεὸς, ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν,

verses.translation: Let God bless us; and let all the ends of the earth fear him.

translations.grk: εὐλογήσαι ἡμᾶς ὁ Θεὸς, καὶ φοβηθήτωσαν αὐτὸν πάντα τὰ πέρατα τῆς γῆς.
